speaker: dad
igboText: Nwa m nwanyị, emume a buru ibu nke ukwuu!
englishText: My daughter, this celebration is huge!
statement: Dad says the celebration is very big.
falseStatement: Dad says the celebration is small.

speaker: daughter
igboText: Ee, Papa. Ndị ọbịa nọ ebe niile.
englishText: Yes, Dad. There are guests everywhere.
statement: The daughter says there are guests everywhere.
falseStatement: The daughter says there are no guests anywhere.

speaker: dad
igboText: E nwere nri, mmanya nkwu, abụ, na ịgba.
englishText: There's food, palm wine, songs, and drumming.
statement: Dad says there is food, palm wine, songs, and drumming.
falseStatement: Dad says there is food, juice, songs, and drumming.

speaker: daughter
statement: The daughter points at a masquerade.
falseStatement: The daughter points at a dancing man.

speaker: dad
falseStatement: Dad says he doesn't see it.

speaker: daughter
igboText: Papa, ị ga-eso mmanwụ gbaa egwu?
englishText: Dad, are you going to dance with the masquerade?
statement: The daughter asks if Dad will dance with the masquerade.
falseStatement: The daughter asks if Dad will sing with the masquerade.

speaker: daughter
statement: The daughter asks if he is serious.
falseStatement: The daughter asks if he is joking.

speaker: dad
igboText: Anyị nọ n'oriri dị ka agbamakwukwo di na nwunye ma ọ bụ ụbọchị ọmụmụ.
englishText: We're at a festival like a wedding or birthday.
statement: Dad says they are at a festival like a wedding or birthday.
falseStatement: Dad says they are at a parade like a wedding or birthday.

speaker: daughter
statement: The daughter asks again if he will dance.
falseStatement: The daughter asks if he will sing.

speaker: daughter
englishText: What are you going to do?
statement: The daughter asks what he will do.
falseStatement: The daughter asks where he will go.

speaker: dad
igboText: Aga m eri nri, ṅụọ obere mmanya nkwu, chọta oche, ma hie obere ụra!
englishText: I'm going to eat food, drink a little palm wine, find a chair, and take a nap!
statement: Dad says he will eat, drink a little palm wine, find a chair, and nap.
falseStatement: Dad says he will eat, drink a lot of palm wine, dance, and nap.
